title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - BackupPolicy
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/BackupPolicy. Describe data protection features based on Backup for storage services. Subclass of DataProtectionPolicy per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the DataProtectionPolicy model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'BackupPolicy'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

backupLocation.description: Relationship. Where data backups are located. Links to one or more Resource entities.

backupReplication.description: Relationship. Backups replication policy, if any. Links to one or more ReplicationPolicy entities.

protectionFrequency.description: Property. Frequency at which data are captured/protected. Controlled-vocabulary value (ProtectionFrequency), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

protectionRetention.description: Relationship. How long captured/protected data are kept available. Links to a RetentionDuration entity.

protectionMethod.description: Property. Method used to protect data, e.g. full copy, incremental. Controlled-vocabulary value (ProtectionMethod), enumeration not resolved in this pass.
